location_description:
Carney is an unincorporated community and census-designated place in Baltimore County, Maryland, United States. The population was 29,941 at the 2010 census. 


== Geography ==
Carney is located at 39°23′48″N 76°31′27″W (39.396707, −76.524078).According to the United States Census Bureau, the CDP has a total area of 7.0 square miles (18 km2), all land.
